questions.stem: Why is selective compliance useful for vertical insertion?

options.text: Vertical compliance is maximized while horizontal motion is completely locked
All four joints must be passive during insertion
The arm must have equal stiffness in every direction

questions.stem: Which directional stiffness pattern explains the SCARA’s suitability for many insertion and electronic assembly tasks?

options.text: Uniform high stiffness in every direction, with no intentionally compliant plane.
High rotational speed eliminates the need to consider directional stiffness.
Relatively stiff vertically and compliant in the horizontal plane.
Relatively compliant vertically and rigid in every horizontal direction.
